# Overview

We will cover the implementation the fixed effects (within) estimator and the random effects estimator. For Mitchell, we will cover the second half of Chapter 5 on formatting.

  1. Fixed Effects (Within) Estimator
  2. Random Effects Estimator
  3. Formatting
